notes.title: V1.02 Released
notes.notes:
We have pushed a new update to Sunrider Academy, bringing it to V1.02

Change log
-Added new cheat which unlocks all four routes, gives high starting stats, and skips the common route, which unlocks in the main menu after clearing the game once
-RNG is more forgiving
-Text in message box is now thicker
-Fixed some graphical glitches in Sola's route

notes.title: V1.01 Released
notes.notes:
V1.01 of Sunrider Academy has been released

Changelog
-Waifu Mode is now god mode. The random number generator should be mostly turned off so activities should be jammed at a 99% success rate.
-Fixed bug in shop menu where you couldn't scroll far enough to buy all the items
-Fixed bug where you couldn't give Sola a holo if her affection was maxed
-You no longer need to buy Sola's holo or the bento boxes to get the Soldout achievement





UPDATE INSTRUCTIONS

The update is provided as-is with no guarntees of save compatibility. (Although all my saves from V0.9++ load fine.) To install it, right click Sunrider Academy in your library, go to the beta tab, and enter password

huig6d4s46sxgf

Opt into "testing" and the game should update.

Once updated, you should see V1.01 in the bottom left side of the main menu.

notes.title: March Content Update
notes.notes:
A content update has been added to Sunrider Academy. With this update, you can now date Chigara, adding about 4-5 more hours of content to the game.

Change log

Chigara V1.01
-Improved mod compatibility
-Added Sola's default birthday event

Chigara V1.00
-KUMA SHOCKU: You can no longer save scum competitions or exams 
-Higher and lower difficulties adjusted - the impact of changing difficulty levels on dice rolls has been reduced, but the difficulty of competitions and exams now change based on the difficulty setting
-Club stats now appear on the campus map during club hours
-.rpyc are now shipped with the game, reducing the chance of save corruptions
-Chigara route now complete

Chigara M6:
-Liberation Day park party loop fixed
-Typos fixed
-Monolith dream glitch fixed 
-Tier 4 club items Inventory glitch fixed 
-Random conversations no longer trigger for girls you have 10 hearts with 
-Chigara route M4 & M5 content added

Full Change Log here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/340730/discussions/0/604941528482939470/

notes.title: Feb Major Content Update
notes.notes:
We have just delivered a major content update to Sunrider Academy.

You can now completely play through the entire game and go out with Sola. There is now approximately 12 hours of content now. Further, additional items, gameplay tweaks, and features have been added as well.



CHANGE LOG

Sola M7-10
-LAMENT! The Alpaca Blanket has been nerfed. It now only works 50% of the time
-Memory Foam Pillow - purchase to reduce nightly ability loss
-Super expensive tier 4 club items added
-Competitions are a bit easier
-Impact of RNG reduced on competitions
-You can now check "Quick Activities" in the prefs to make the activity animations last 0.5 seconds
-Sola Arc complete


Sola M5-6
-Retry Charm nerfed! They now come with 20 charges and you have to buy a new one once all the charges are out
-Girls now get bored of talking about the same topics quicker
-Girls now consider their current affection level less when talking to you
-Club competitions are initially a bit easier, but the increase in difficulty level per month is larger
-Museum job now gets more difficult as the game progresses
-Store job now gets more difficult as the game progresses
-Class gets even more difficult as the game progresses
-Typos fixed
-Two new months of story content

CommonM4
-Working out at gym buffed from +2 Fitness to +3 Fitness
-Difficulty of club competitions raised slightly
-Affection gain from winning competitions decreased
-Slightly increased success chance of raising club readiness
-Added a bunch of gifts to purchase
-Inventory is now scrollable
-"Set of set of lab beakers" typo fixed
-Fixed position of hearts on Little Sister Intel screen
-Chance of nightly luck degradation slightly increased
-New month of story content for Sola arc

CommonM3
-Retry Charm item added > with this item, you can retry a failed activity by clicking on the red "x" which appears when you fail the roll. Just mind your stress stat because this will rapidly increase it. (Eh, this broke the game in so many different ways and is the main reason why M3 took longer than M2...)
-Some other less interesting items added
-Arcade nerfed > now restores 4 stress and costs 2 Int instead of restoring 5 Stress and costing 1 Int
-Museum nerfed > now costs 2 credits
-Good Karma class nerfed > now starts with 8 Fit, 5 Int, 5 Cha, 25 Luck instead of 8 Fit, Int, Cha, and 30 Luck.
-All competitions reworked > Gap between bronze and gold increased, difficulty level increased
-Exam formula a bit modified...?
-And of course, a whole new month of story content
-Nightly luck degradation increased (The higher your luck, the degradation can range between 1 to 5 Luck per hour of sleep)
-Encounter charm and Major Study charm now deduct the correct amount of creds

CommonM2
-Arcade relieves 5 Stress instead of 4, but now costs 1 Int
-Swim, kendo, science competitions, and exams now easier
-Eroge now busts 20 stress, not 14.
-Raising club morale now gives 3 Morale, not 2
-All jobs now pay 1 more credit
-Bunch of new items
-Bunch of new features... lol


M1Build3
-Museum success now reduces 1 Stress on top of +3 Int
-Arcade Success now reduces 4 Stress instead of 3
-Recruitment failure now increases 1 Stress instead of 2
-Swim competition, kendo competition, and final exams are now a bit easier
-Going to the shrine now revamped: Donate money to increase chances of success, or give a big 5 cred donation for +4 Luck
-Recruitment is now a bit easier (Still hard to go over 5 members, but now easier to save a club with less than 5 members)
-If a club goes below 5 members, you now have 6 days to fix, not 3
-New Item: Purchase an eroge at the shop for 20 creds for an instant 14 stress reduction
-Balanced shinai and swim goggles now cost 30 creds instead of 40.
-Game now warns you if you forget to do homework
-Shrine visit glitch reported by Endershadow fixed (Corresponding museum visit glitch also fixed)
-M1 Sola date more likely to trigger
-M1 Winter festival event more likely to trigger


M1Build2
-Going to the arcade now is much more likely to reduce stress. With 0 luck, you always have a 80% chance of succeeding no matter what now.
-Going to the park is also more likely to reduce stress, same as with the arcade.
-You can now gain more stress before getting sick.
-When you're sick, you can now go to the store and buy medicine for 15 creds to temporarily relieve the sickness.
-When you're sick, you bad end quicker after you reach the point of no return
-Adjusted starting stats to have higher fitness to make sicknesses less common
